description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called ColorFilters, which showcases various color filter effects applied to drawable resources, demonstrating the use of PorterDuff color filters and modes in Android graphics.

classes.name: ColorFilters
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes the view and manages the color filter demonstration.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View that handles drawing images with different color filters and user interaction to change modes and colors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: addToTheRight
methods.description: Positions a drawable to the right of the previous drawable for layout purposes.

methods.name: swapPaintColors
methods.description: Alternates the colors of the Paint objects used for drawing.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the activity's title to reflect the current color filter mode.

methods.name: drawSample
methods.description: Draws a drawable with a specified color filter on the canvas.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to render the color filter samples.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input to cycle through modes and toggle paint colors.
